name: Sau San Tong Holdings Limited
summary: Sau San Tong Holdings Limited, founded in 2000 and headquartered in Central, Hong Kong, is an investment holding company that distributes cosmetics and skin care products in Hong Kong and China. Through slimming centers under the Sau San Tong and IPRO brands it offers body slimming, weight management and facial treatments. It also sells other health and beauty goods, lends money, invests in securities, holds property and franchises its services.
